bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$1"; }
for g in -1003847210571 -1002373696859 -1003770334893; do
 n="$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=$g AND title ILIKE '%プロフ%'")"
 if test "$n" -gt 0; then echo "PROFILE_DM_PIN_MATCH=$g:$n"; fi
 n="$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE chat_id=$g AND (purpose='profile' OR title ILIKE '%プロフ%')")"
 if test "$n" -gt 0; then echo "PROFILE_POSTING_TOPIC_MATCH=$g:$n"; fi
 n="$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM general_guide_topics WHERE chat_id=$g")"
 echo "BOARD_GUIDE_COUNT=$g:$n"
done
echo PROFILE_ALTERNATIVE_MAPPINGS_CHECKED=PASS
